title: Reaper
html:
Reaper is a Death Domain cleric passive feature that allows the cleric to target two creatures with Necromancy cantrips.

Description

Your Necromancy cantrips that only target 1 creature can target an additional creature.

How to learn

Classes:

  • Class level 1: Death Domain

Notes

  • This effect specifically applies to these cantrips:  Bone Chill,  Bursting Sinew, and  Toll the Dead.
  • This effect does not stack with  Adroit Caster.
